# SwingRush

> The world’s first arena golf gauntlet: ten skills challenges, hundreds of golfers, one finish line.

Canonical site: https://www.swingrushgolf.com

## Primary pages

- Home: https://www.swingrushgolf.com/
- Skills challenges: https://www.swingrushgolf.com/challenges
- How it works: https://www.swingrushgolf.com/how-it-works
- Locations: https://www.swingrushgolf.com/locations
- Join the waitlist: https://www.swingrushgolf.com/waitlist

## About

SwingRush is a timed arena golf experience. Players complete ten skills challenges solo or on a team and race to the finish line — no traditional scorecard.
